title: EALM: Introducing Multidimensional Ethical Alignment in Conversational Information Retrieval
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark does not measure aspects of faith or religion. It measures alignment with secular ethical concepts such as justice, deontology, virtue, utilitarianism, and commonsense morality.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as its focus is on secular ethical alignment.
